The '''Veron Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mektrun sector/Legends|Mektrun sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Veron Minor]], [[Sileron]], and [[Trieron]].
